name: Paperless-ngx
description: Paperless-ngx is a document management system that transforms physical and digital documents into a searchable archive.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent Paperless application data, search index and SQLite database when SQLite is used.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Original documents, archive files and thumbnails managed by Paperless.

paths.name: Consume
paths.description: Drop documents here for automatic consumption.

paths.name: Export
paths.description: Destination used by the Paperless document exporter.

variables.name: Valkey / Redis URL
variables.description: Required Redis-compatible broker URL. Example: redis://:password@valkey-paperless:6379.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Required secret used for sessions and cryptographic signing. Generate a long random value before first startup.

variables.name: Database Engine
variables.description: Database backend. This single-container template defaults to SQLite.

variables.name: OCR Language
variables.description: Primary OCR language. Multiple languages can be combined, for example spa+eng.

variables.name: Additional OCR Languages
variables.description: Optional additional Tesseract language packages to install, as a space-separated list.

variables.name: Time Zone
variables.description: Timezone used by Paperless. Change this to your local timezone if required.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Optional canonical external URL, for example https://paperless.example.com.

variables.name: Filename Format
variables.description: Optional template used to generate document filenames.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: Host UID used by Paperless for mounted files and directories. MOS recommended default: 500.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Host GID used by Paperless for mounted files and directories. MOS recommended default: 500.
